# Entro Ethiopia

> Entro Ethiopia Software Development PLC is a software and hardware systems company in Megnagna, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia.

## Company
- Legal name: Entro Ethiopia Software Development PLC
- Brand: Entro Ethiopia
- Website: https://www.entroethiopia.com/
- Phone: +251 979 113 638
- Email: entro12@entroethiopia.com
- Address: Megnagna, Hibret Bldg, Office No. H7-702, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia
- TIN: 0095875999

## What we do
- Custom software development
- Web development (Next.js, React)
- AI solutions and automation
- ERP and business systems
- Hardware systems: CCTV installation, door access control, GPS vehicle tracking, attendance machines
- Centralized integration of security, fleet, and workforce systems into web dashboards
